story.text: 남부시장 청년몰 안, 허름한 콩나물국밥집 앞에 줄이 구불구불 이어져 있었다. "여기가 그렇게 유명하다며?" 나는 눈을 크게 떴다.
story.reading: nam-bu-si-jang cheong-nyeon-mol an, heo-reum-han kong-na-mul-guk-bap-jib ap-e jul-i gu-bul-gu-bul i-eo-jyeo iss-eot-da. yeo-gi-ga geu-reo-ke yu-myeong-ha-da-myeo? na-neun nun-eul keu-ge tteot-da.
story.en: Inside Nambu Market's youth mall, a line snaked in front of a plain-looking bean-sprout soup place. "This is supposed to be that famous?" I widened my eyes.

story.text: "일단 줄을 서. 맛없으면 내가 다 책임진다." 하늘이 자신만만하게 나를 줄 끝으로 이끌었다.
story.reading: il-dan jul-eul seo. mas-eop-seu-myeon nae-ga da chaeg-im-jin-da. ha-neul-i ja-sin-man-man-ha-ge na-reul jul kkeut-eu-ro i-kkeul-eot-da.
story.en: "Just get in line first. If it's no good, I'll take full responsibility." Haneul confidently led me to the back of the line.

story.text: 삼십 분이 지나도 줄은 줄어들 기미가 없었다. "웨이팅이 너무 긴 거 아니에요?" 내가 투덜대자, 그는 태연하게 휴대폰만 들여다봤다.
story.reading: sam-sip bun-i ji-na-do jul-eun jul-eo-deul gi-mi-ga eop-seot-da. we-i-ting-i neo-mu gin geo a-ni-e-yo? nae-ga tu-deol-dae-ja, geu-neun tae-yeon-ha-ge hyu-dae-pon-man deul-yeo-da-bwat-da.
story.en: Thirty minutes passed and the line barely moved. "Isn't this waiting time way too long?" I grumbled, but he just calmly stared at his phone.

story.text: 드디어 자리에 앉자 하늘이 메뉴판도 안 보고 외쳤다. "곱빼기 두 그릇이요." "그렇게 많이?" 내가 놀라자, 그는 어깨를 으쓱했다. "너 원래 잘 먹잖아."
story.reading: deu-di-eo ja-ri-e anj-ja ha-neul-i me-nyu-pan-do an bo-go oe-chyeot-da. gop-ppae-gi du geu-reut-i-yo. geu-reo-ke man-i? nae-ga nol-la-ja, geu-neun eo-kkae-reul eu-sseuk-haet-da. neo won-lae jal meok-jan-a.
story.en: We finally sat down, and Haneul called out without even looking at the menu: "Two extra-large bowls." "That much?" I was surprised, but he just shrugged. "You always eat a lot anyway."

story.text: 국밥이 나오자 그는 자기 그릇에서 계란을 슬쩍 내 쪽으로 밀어줬다. 말없이 나눠 먹는 그 손짓이 익숙했다.
story.reading: guk-bab-i na-o-ja geu-neun ja-gi geu-reus-e-seo gye-ran-eul seul-jjeok nae jjog-eu-ro mil-eo-jwot-da. mal-eop-si na-nwo meong-neun geu son-jis-i ik-suk-haet-da.
story.en: When the soup arrived, he quietly slid the egg from his bowl over to mine. That wordless gesture of sharing food felt familiar.

story.text: 다 먹고도 성에 안 찼는지, 하늘은 순대 한 접시를 더 포장했다. "숙소 가서 야식으로 먹자." 그의 배려는 늘 이렇게 조용했다.
story.reading: da meok-go-do seong-e an chass-neun-ji, ha-neul-eun sun-dae han jeop-si-reul deo po-jang-haet-da. suk-so ga-seo ya-sig-eu-ro meok-ja. geu-ui bae-ryeo-neun neul i-reo-ke jo-yong-haet-da.
story.en: Even after finishing, it seemed like he wasn't satisfied, so Haneul got another plate of sundae packed to go. "We'll eat it as a late-night snack back at the room." His thoughtfulness was always this quiet.

story.text: 시장을 나서며 배가 두둑해진 나는 웃음이 났다. 긴 웨이팅도, 그와 함께라면 기다릴 만한 시간이었다.
story.reading: si-jang-eul na-seo-myeo bae-ga du-duk-hae-jin na-neun us-eum-i nat-da. gin we-i-ting-do, geu-wa ham-kke-ra-myeon gi-da-ril man-han si-gan-i-eot-da.
story.en: Walking out of the market with a nice full stomach, I couldn't help but smile. Even the long wait — with him, it was time worth waiting through.

words.example_en: The wait at this restaurant is an hour.

words.example: 우리는 삼십 분 동안 줄을 섰다.
words.example_reading: u-ri-neun sam-sip bun dong-an jul-eul seot-da
words.example_en: We stood in line for thirty minutes.
I was hungry so I ordered a double portion.

words.meaning: to pack/box up food to go
words.example_en: I packed the leftover food to go.
I shared food with my friend.
